summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a `postinstall` lifecycle script that runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs a JSON payload containing hostname, install path (__dirname), current working directory, Node version, and package name to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plaintext HTTP. The same beacon is also fired from `index.js` on require. `index.js` otherwise exports a Proxy that returns a no-op for every property access, so bundlers that accidentally import this package do not crash and the install-time callback completes silently. The package self-describes as a 'Compatibility shim' and has no functional code backing that description; its only observable behavior is the beacon. The destination is an unrelated bare IP, not a publisher-matching domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
